title: Each orchestrating session works in its own clone or worktree
goal: kb/_self/backlog.md and /kb-sprint say that a second orchestrator runs from its own clone or git worktree, never the checkout another session works in, and /kb-sprint run checks that git status shows only its own changes before it lands
notes: Failure it answers (SP-qdq57zu3 retrospective): two orchestrators shared one working tree; the other session's uncommitted ql_deliver.py and test_querylog_e2e.py edits blocked this sprint's kbgit.py sync and failed its review story's tests.py, and that session then pushed this sprint's local commits under its own gate.
